dimensions.assessment: Affects home-schooled students seeking federal student financial aid for higher education.
dimensions.evidence: a student who has completed a secondary school education in a home school setting that is treated as a home school or private school under State law shall be considered a high school graduate.

dimensions.assessment: Clarifies eligibility criteria for federal student aid, removing potential administrative barriers for home school graduates.
dimensions.evidence: For purposes of this title, a student who has completed a secondary school education in a home school setting... shall be considered a high school graduate.

dimensions.assessment: May impact the volume of federal student aid distributed by clarifying student eligibility.
Amends a specific section of the Higher Education Act of 1965 regarding federal student aid eligibility definitions.
dimensions.evidence: Section 484(d) of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1091(d)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Makes a permanent change to federal student aid qualification statutes.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to ensure that students completing secondary school in state-recognized home school settings are legally considered high school graduates for federal student aid.
